checks:
∀ (X : Type*) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (s : ℝ) (A : Set X),
  hausdorffMeasure s A = ⨆ (δ : ℝ≥0∞) (_ : 0 < δ), YuiBasis.Content s δ A

∀ (X : Type*) [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (A : Set X) (d : ℝ≥0),
  ((d : ℝ≥0∞) < dimH A → hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A = ⊤) ∧
  (dimH A < (d : ℝ≥0∞) → hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A = 0) ∧
  (hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A ≠ ⊤ → dimH A ≤ (d : ℝ≥0∞)) ∧
  (hausdorffMeasure (d : ℝ) A = ⊤ → (d : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ dimH A)

∀ (X Y : Type*) [EMetricSpace X] [EMetricSpace Y] (K L : ℝ≥0) (f : X → Y)
  (hf : LipschitzWith K f) (hg : AntilipschitzWith L f) (A : Set X),
  (dimH (f '' A) ≤ dimH A ∧ dimH A ≤ dimH (f '' A)) ∧
  (∀ B : Set X, A ⊆ B → dimH A ≤ dimH B)
∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (YuiBasis.Ambient n)), dimH A ≤ (n : ℝ≥0∞) ∧ dimH A ≠ ⊤

∀ (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (f : ℕ → X → ℝ≥0∞),
  (∀ i, AEMeasurable (f i) μ) →
  (∫⁻ x, ∑' i, f i x ∂μ) = ∑' i, ∫⁻ x, f i x ∂μ

∀ (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (S : Set X),
  MeasurableSet S → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞,
  (∫⁻ x, S.indicator (fun _ => c) x ∂μ) = c * μ S

∀ (X : Type*) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X),
  (∀ f g : X → ℝ≥0∞, (∀ x, f x ≤ g x) →
    (∫⁻ x, f x ∂μ) ≤ ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ) ∧
  (∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, (∫⁻ _x : X, c ∂μ) = c * μ Set.univ)

(∀ B : Set ℝ, Bornology.IsBounded B →
  B ⊆ Set.Icc (sInf B) (sSup B) ∧
  volume (Set.Icc (sInf B) (sSup B)) = Metric.ediam B) ∧
  (∀ a b : ℝ, volume (Set.Icc a b) = ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)) ∧
  volume (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) = 1
∀ q : ℝ, 0 ≤ q → Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x ^ q)

∀ (X Y : Type*) [EMetricSpace X] [EMetricSpace Y] (K : ℝ≥0) (f : X → Y),
  LipschitzWith K f → ∀ A : Set X,
  Metric.ediam (f '' A) ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞) * Metric.ediam A
